steps.what: Inspect grounds, facilities, and equipment routinely
Determine the necessity of repairs or maintenance

tasks.design: The manager inspects grounds, facilities, and equipment routinely and determines the necessity of repairs or maintenance. Nothing is written to {OPS_SYSTEM} in this task. The inspection and the decision stay at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager walks the grounds and decides on the spot.
tasks.enabler_now: No stored row shortens the walk or the decision.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing the fault and judging whether it needs work stay physical.
tasks.human_edge: The manager calls a contractor when the fault is unsafe.
tasks.altitude: The inspection stays the week. Nothing in it is shortened.

reach.task: Quote a repair the manager has judged necessary
reach.learn: Which faults must be made safe the same day.

evidence.claim: Routine inspection and the decision that a repair is necessary stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts on the grounds and ends when the manager has decided what needs repair, or stops.
No new record is required for the walk. Upkeep is zero.
The decision is the manager's. A later work order, if any, is a different task.
unknowns: How often each site is inspected.
research_questions: Which faults did the manager judge necessary on the last round?

already_counted.description: Inspecting grounds, facilities, and equipment is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the inspection adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every site is still walked. High: the same inspection remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Direct and coordinate activities of staff and contract personnel
Evaluate their performance in the conversation

tasks.design: The manager directs and coordinates the activities of staff and contract personnel and evaluates their performance in conversation. Nothing is written to {DOCS}. No score is stored. The direction and the conversation stay at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager tells people the day's work and talks about how it went.
tasks.enabler_now: No roster tool is introduced. The conversation is the evaluation.
tasks.still_hard: Judging a person's work stays with the manager, in the conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not write a score and does not compare people on a list.
tasks.altitude: Directing the day and talking about performance stay in person. No record of a score is added.

reach.task: Do the work the manager directed
reach.learn: Which duties that person cannot safely do.

evidence.claim: Directing staff and discussing performance stay a conversation. No score is stored.
Notes about how a named employee performs are personal data, and a works council may have to agree before such notes are systematised.

assumptions: The work starts with the day's jobs and ends when the manager has directed the people and spoken about the work, or stops.
No performance score is written. Upkeep is zero.
Contract personnel are directed in the same conversation. They are not scored.
unknowns: Whether a works council must be consulted before any staff note is kept.
research_questions: How often did the evaluation stay a conversation with nothing written?

already_counted.description: Directing staff and contract personnel is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: no score and no roster are added.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every direction is still given in person. High: the same conversations remain, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Meet boards about disputes and issues

steps.what: Meet with boards of directors and committees
Discuss and resolve legal and environmental issues or disputes between neighbors

tasks.design: The manager meets boards of directors and committees to discuss and resolve legal and environmental issues or disputes between neighbors. Nothing is filed to {DOCS} in this task. The meeting stays at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager sits with the board and works through the dispute.
tasks.enabler_now: No stored brief shortens the meeting.
tasks.still_hard: Discussing the issue and resolving it stay with the people in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not declare a dispute resolved if the neighbors have not been heard.
tasks.altitude: The board meeting stays the work. Nothing in it is shortened.

reach.task: Decide a resolution the board must vote
reach.learn: Which disputes the board will not hear.

evidence.claim: Meetings with a board about legal, environmental, or neighbor disputes stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts when the board meets and ends when the issue is resolved or deferred, or the manager stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
A legal filing, if one is needed, is a different task.
unknowns: Which disputes the board expects the manager to settle before the meeting.
research_questions: How often did a neighbor dispute stay unresolved after the meeting?

already_counted.description: Discussing and resolving neighbor disputes is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the meeting adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every dispute is still heard in the meeting. High: the same meeting remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the management rules and regulations
Resolve problems following those rules and regulations

tasks.design: The manager investigates complaints, disturbances, and violations and resolves problems, following management rules and regulations. {DOCS} opens the stored rule text. A missing rule stays blank. The investigation and the resolution stay at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager looked up the rule in a binder and then went to the site.
tasks.enabler_now: A rule identifier can open text the organisation already holds.
tasks.still_hard: Investigating what happened and resolving it stay in person.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not close a complaint the rule does not cover.
tasks.altitude: The investigation stays the work. Only finding the rule text is shorter.

evidence.claim: A stored rule identifier can open the rule text. Investigating and resolving the complaint stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a complaint and ends when the manager has resolved it or stopped.
A rule row has rule identifier and text, entered by the organisation. A missing rule is left blank and the manager does not invent one.
Opening the rule does not shorten the investigation. No one is scored.
unknowns: Which complaints must be escalated to the owner or the board.
research_questions: How often was the rule text missing, so the manager used the binder?

already_counted.description: Investigating complaints and violations is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: opening a rule adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the rule is often missing, so the investigation is unchanged. High: the rule opens, and investigating the complaint still takes the visit. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager still inspects sites, meets people, and decides rents, eligibility, and staff matters. A payment, contract, purchase, advertisement, or record is sent or written only after the manager accepts that version.
reach: An owner receives only a budget or a payment list the manager has accepted.
A contractor receives only a bid request or a contract the manager has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when an amount, a date, or a required document is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a send or a write.
Keep site inspections, tenant conversations, and eligibility decisions in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every property has a budget and a record the owner can trust, and the manager still decides the exception.
